//! The S1 principal store — the identity SYSTEM-OF-RECORD, durable by contract (SI-018). On this
//! shape it is backed by an in-memory map with NO pool: it loses ALL state on restart.
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

/// The shared inner state behind the store handle (the in-memory backing).
#[derive(Default)]
struct Inner {
    /// Committed principal rows, keyed by `(tenant, region)` partition then `principal_id`.
    partitions: BTreeMap<(String, String), BTreeMap<String, PrincipalRow>>,
}

/// The S1 principal store (system-of-record). RED: in-memory, no pool/connection field.
pub struct PrincipalStore {
    inner: Arc<Mutex<Inner>>,
}
